description: This is a PHP source file defining an admin controller class 'Log' within the OpenCart framework. The class manages log file viewing, downloading, and clearing functionalities within the admin panel.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Admin controller class for managing system logs, including viewing log files, downloading specific logs, and clearing logs.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of log files with options to view, download, or clear logs.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading of a specific log file after validating its existence and size.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of a specified log file, with permission checks and error handling.
